objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Register on the task manager, find where it hands your input to a shell, run a command on the server, and read /ctf/flag.
hints: The tutorials' A1 Injection entry is about a shell, not SQL. Which feature stores files on disk?
When a project file is uploaded, the server moves it with a shell command built from a value you choose.

steps.title: Find the feature
steps.prompt: Which project feature writes what you send to the server's disk?

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which form field of that feature ends up in the shell command? (its name)

steps.title: Find the sink
steps.prompt: Which Python function runs that command?

steps.title: Name the flaw
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets your value run a command of its own?
